description:
Copy a file from a computer into the person's Library, so they can open it.

WHEN TO USE:
- A result the person should keep or see: a report, a chart, a converted document, a download.

GOOD TO KNOW: it creates a new file and never overwrites a Library file; pick a new name if one exists. One file at a time (zip folders first, with computer_run).

RETURNS: library_path (where it was saved) and its size.

computer.description: The computer's name, as computer_list shows it (for example "research").

library_path.description: New file name in the Library, for example "Reports/q3-chart.png". The folder must exist.

source.description: The file on the computer; relative paths start in its home folder.

name: computer_copy_out
